title: Replace historical parity donors with direct 3.33-point fallback
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Ок, пусть будет 3.33 для верности. Отказываемся от доноров.

1. Оставить неизменными.
2. Да, только там, где точную комиссию определить нельзя.



Я правильно понимаю, что это коснётся только истории? А для всех новых ставок у нас будут данные?
Но ведь у нас все новые ставки уже считаются с Net. Мы проходим только по старым.
Давай понимать по старыми ставки, сделанные до 10.08.20266

scope.goal: For still-unfinished HistoricalGrossNetParity contributions originating before 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z, preserve exact Fee accounting and replace every donor lookup with a direct fixed fallback satisfying Net ROI = Gross ROI - 3.33 percentage points, without rewriting completed accounting or changing the ordinary accounting path for new bets.
inScope: The existing HistoricalGrossNetParity workflow for canonical Gross-selected Paper and Live contributions whose proved originating entry is strictly before 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z.
Existing VenueReported, authoritative-Fee Net repair, complete exact local evidence, and exact historical CLOB calculation paths, with their current precedence and validation.
A direct terminal fixed fallback for a financially valid unresolved target when exact Fee accounting is unavailable: Fee = ROUND_AWAY_FROM_ZERO(GrossRoiBasisUsd * 0.0333, 8) and Net = Gross - Fee.
Removal of donor discovery, donor preview, donor matching, and donor-selection revalidation from every new fallback decision made by HistoricalGrossNetParity.
Backward-compatible reading and preservation of already completed exact, donor, and fixed HistoricalGrossNetParity accounting and audit evidence.
Focused tests and documentation needed to prove the changed historical fallback and unchanged ordinary new-bet accounting boundary.
outOfScope: Rewriting any contribution already terminally completed under calculation version historical-gross-net-parity-v1, including an existing exact, donor, or fixed result.
Changing Gross PnL, Gross ROI, GrossRoiBasisUsd, stake/cost basis, source selection, lineage, component graphs, execution, settlement, signals, prices, sizes, risk logic, or strategy ordering.
Applying 3.33 points when a VenueReported, authoritative, complete exact local, or exact historical CLOB Fee is available.
Treating an unproved identity, Gross amount, ROI basis, lineage, component graph, origin cutoff, or other structural invariant as merely unavailable Fee; those targets remain explicit deferrals.

Changing the ordinary fee/Net calculation for new or post-cutoff Paper and Live bets, creating a new VenueReported ingress, or guaranteeing that external CLOB fee-schedule data can never be unavailable.
Deleting legacy donor models, hashes, storage readers, or audit compatibility required to preserve completed historical records.
Production database mutation, service deployment, service restart, configuration mutation, or trading action during this local implementation task.
scope.periodOrFilter: Only canonical HistoricalGrossNetParity contributions with proved originating entry strictly earlier than 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z, UTC, that are not already terminally completed for calculation version historical-gross-net-parity-v1.
scope.firstVerification: Trace the current historical exact-to-fallback processor, donor-preview invocation, decision construction, storage selection revalidation, permanent-audit exclusion, late VenueReported revision path, and ordinary Paper/Live fee-accounting services; compare with a read-only Production snapshot before editing.

requirements.text: Limit the changed behavior to unfinished historical contributions originating before 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z and leave ordinary new-bet Fee/Net accounting unchanged.
requirements.sourceQuote: Но ведь у нас все новые ставки уже считаются с Net. Мы проходим только по старым.
acceptanceCriteria: HistoricalGrossNetParity retains its exact originating-entry predicate strictly before 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z UTC and its current canonical Gross contribution set.

The existing online Paper fill/position/run/settlement accounting and Live-order accounting paths are unchanged; they continue to persist Calculated or VenueReported Fee when available and explicit CalculationUnavailable when required external evidence is unavailable.
No post-cutoff row becomes eligible for the fixed historical fallback, and no execution, order, fill, settlement, strategy signal, risk, or balance behavior changes as part of this task.
Production preview evidence records the exact control target 5a4ef4c9-dc18-41b5-a3cd-92fb7b3c0795 as unresolved and confirms the ordinary new-bet path independently from source inspection.

verification.expected: Focused tests prove the unchanged strict historical cutoff and ordinary Paper/Live fee-accounting behavior while the historical fallback changes independently.

requirements.text: When exact historical Fee accounting is unavailable for a financially valid unresolved target, bypass donors and immediately apply a fixed 3.33-percentage-point fallback.
requirements.sourceQuote: Ок, пусть будет 3.33 для верности. Отказываемся от доноров.
acceptanceCriteria: VenueReported Fee, authoritative-Fee Net repair, complete exact local evidence, and a successful exact historical CLOB calculation retain precedence over the fixed fallback.

For a positive proved Gross ROI basis B, the fallback persists Fee = ROUND_AWAY_FROM_ZERO(B * 0.0333, 8), Net = Gross - Fee, decision kind Fixed0p0333, and a distinct versioned direct-fixed calculation source/evidence payload.
A basis of 100.00 produces Fee 3.33000000; a basis of 12.34 produces Fee 0.41092200; before display rounding the contribution algebra satisfies Net ROI = Gross ROI - 3.33 percentage points.
The processor does not construct donor candidate order, call donor preview storage, run donor matching, or provide donor candidates to a new fixed Paper or Live accounting transaction.

Storage accepts and atomically revalidates the new direct fixed decision without recomputing donor selection; CAS, cutoff, stable tuple, lineage, component, Gross, basis, audit, reconciliation, and Live balance-ordering guards remain enforced.
A nonpositive proved basis retains the existing NonpositiveBasis terminal behavior; structural or evidentiary conflicts remain deferred and never receive a fabricated fixed Fee.

verification.expected: Tests prove exact-before-fixed precedence, exact 0.0333 coefficient and rounding, no donor calls or revalidation for new fallback decisions, preserved financial guards, and Paper/Live atomic application.

requirements.text: Leave all already completed HistoricalGrossNetParity accounting unchanged and retain backward compatibility for legacy donor/fixed audit evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: The permanent calculation-version audit exclusion remains unchanged, so a completed exact, DonorRatio, Fixed0p033, or Fixed0p0333 contribution is not selected or financially rewritten.
Legacy donor decision kinds, donor evidence, membership/selection hashes, and storage readers remain compatible for completed records even though no new fallback invokes them.
The calculation version remains historical-gross-net-parity-v1 so existing completion evidence continues to exclude completed targets rather than causing a global replay.

The existing strictly newer associated VenueReported revision path may still supersede an earlier non-authoritative historical estimate without changing its authority ordering, idempotency, audit linkage, or balance correction rules.

Production preview evidence records 135262 existing completed ExistingExactPreserved decisions, zero existing donor/fixed decisions, and zero audit rows for the unresolved control target; implementation must preserve the general completed-record contract regardless of the current zero donor/fixed count.

verification.expected: Tests prove completed-row exclusion, legacy donor/fixed compatibility, unchanged calculation version, and unchanged late VenueReported supersession.

requirements.text: Preserve Gross-ordered one-strategy completion, bounded mutation, auditability, and restart safety while making fallback independent of donor runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: The worker still selects the greatest-current-Gross unfinished strategy and completes that strategy before selecting another; exact-to-fallback phase boundaries remain strategy-local.
A fixed fallback target no longer performs a full 3006-strategy donor preview and therefore has no in-memory donor offset or donor-progress loss on restart.
Each target application remains a short atomic idempotent transaction with existing statement/lock timeouts, stable-tuple and CAS checks, immutable audit, reconciliation, and foreground yielding.

Logs and structured counters no longer claim donor work for a direct fixed target; documentation describes exact-to-direct-3.33 precedence, unchanged cutoff, completed-row preservation, and new-bet isolation.
Focused tests, affected solution build, requirement validators, diff checks, and independent semantic review all pass before completion.

verification.command: Run VER-001 through VER-003, build PolyCopyTrader.sln with disposable outputs under the marked D:\CodexTemp run, run git diff --check and requirement validation, and obtain independent semantic review of verbatim requests, approved contract, diff, and evidence.
verification.expected: All checks pass with no donor runtime for new historical fallback decisions, no change to ordinary new-bet accounting, no Production mutation, and no open review findings.
